earth3_dataset.canonical_selectable_set_source: exact non-water province IDs from the authenticated Earth3 production authority

expanded.projection_rule: project persistent national actors without changing sovereignty, dated front, Belarus PRC control, or neutral-war rules

sovereignty_mapping.country_boundary_reference: Natural Earth low-resolution admin-0 boundaries used only to assign modern sovereign labels to coarse Earth3 provinces
sovereignty_mapping.whole_province_rule: assign the country containing the calibrated Earth3 province centroid; low-resolution coastline gaps use the nearest country boundary
sovereignty_mapping.note: This mapping is gameplay geography for the coarse Earth3 province graph and is not a legal border dataset.

neutral_nations.first_attack_scope: entire sovereign nation becomes hostile only to the attacker

controller_balance.rule: target roughly plus-or-minus 15 percent of the four-power mean where geographically coherent
controller_balance.prc_shortfall_policy: report the deficit; never invent disconnected PRC-controlled territory

primary_source.name: DeepStateMAP
primary_source.role: primary visual reference for an owner-approved approximate August 2026 gameplay control line

secondary_source.name: Ukraine has retaken 745 sq km in 'precision' operation this year, Zelenskiy says

whole_province_mapping_rule.rule: Assign whole Earth3 provinces to a close August 2026 gameplay approximation using the dated DeepState visual line and neighboring province continuity. Border provinces may be rounded to the nearest coherent Earth3 province. The result is explicitly subject to owner visual audit before production acceptance.

ukraine_front.note: Owner ruling on 2026-08-16 permits a close gameplay approximation. This is not represented as exact DeepState geometry and is not a prediction of the 2028 battlefield.
